sentences.en: Did you ever get that bank overdraft sorted out?
sentences.zh: 你有没有把银行的透支问题解决掉？

sentences.en: I don't want to end up having to pay an overdraft fee.
sentences.zh: 我不想最后不得不支付透支费用。

sentences.en: Am I responsible for overdraft fees even though the bank made a mistake?
sentences.zh: 即便银行出错，我还是要负责支付透支费用吗？
